title: The historically wrong acidity mediator for scurvy
content: The book identifies this as the historically believed but unproved model: Citrus Fruits act on Scurvy entirely through Acidity. Its chain topology is coherent, but its mediator identity is scientifically wrong.

variables.name: Citrus Fruits
variables.content: The preventive treatment whose mechanism was misunderstood.

variables.name: Acidity
variables.content: The historically presumed mediator, which the source marks as incorrect.

variables.name: Scurvy
variables.content: The disease outcome prevented by the treatment.

arrows.because: The historical model attributed the action of citrus fruits to their acidity.
The historical model treated acidity as the complete mediator of scurvy prevention.
